steps.note: The whey is warmed in a heat exchanger, then steam is blown into it to reach temperature, and it is held in a tube while the protein comes out of solution.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 18 Milk and whey fractionation

sources.text: The temperature, hold, cooling and separation, and the recovery, from the handbook; it gives no pH setpoint and no drying conditions, so none are shown.
